title: Estimate Variance Credit on Insured Payoffs: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
When an insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account is paid off in full, the cost-sharing actually posted is compared with the Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate linked to the account, an estimate of the Good Faith & Price Estimates product, and a dollar credit may be subtracted.

**Definitions.** The cost-sharing posted is the total of the account's deductible, coinsurance and copay liability postings. The tolerance figure is the estimate total of the linked Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate times one plus that estimate's variance review percent (15 percent for the Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate), that is the estimate total times 1.15.

**Clause.** When that estimate's issued date is on or before its scheduled service date and the cost-sharing posted exceeds the tolerance figure, a dollar credit of 0.5 times the excess of the cost-sharing posted over the tolerance figure, rounded half-up to the cent, is subtracted. When that estimate carries an issued date and either no scheduled service date or a scheduled service date before that issued date, and the cost-sharing posted exceeds its estimate total, a flat dollar credit of 25.00 USD is subtracted. Otherwise, including no linked insured estimate with an issued date, nothing is subtracted.

## Methods by case

| Estimate timing | Cost-sharing posted | Credit subtracted |
|---|---|---|
| issued on or before the scheduled service date | above the tolerance figure | one half of the excess over the tolerance figure, rounded half-up to the cent |
| issued on or before the scheduled service date | at or below the tolerance figure | nothing |
| issued, with no scheduled service date or a service date before the issue date | above the estimate total | 25.00 flat |
| issued, with no scheduled service date or a service date before the issue date | at or below the estimate total | nothing |
| no linked estimate with an issued date | any | nothing |

## Worked figures (hypothetical estimate)

- Estimate total 1000.00, issued before its service date: tolerance figure 1150.00. Cost-sharing posted of 1350.00 exceeds it by 200.00, so the credit is 100.00. Cost-sharing of 1150.00 earns nothing.
- Estimate total 1000.00, issued after its scheduled service date: cost-sharing of 1050.00 exceeds the total and earns 25.00; cost-sharing of 1000.00 earns nothing.
